resolution: Compiled-world materials now carry through: the native world_loader (rjit game play) renders material-skinned faces with their actual WGSL shader instead of a flat fallback color. Producer (worldGeometry) ships each {kind:'material'} face skin's shader recipe (WGSL + data[]) content-addressed into new MATERIALS/MATERIAL_REFS map-lumps; the Zig loader decodes them and, via a new SHARED framework primitive gpu/material_tex.zig (run a shader to a texture, install under a key the 3D pipeline samples), materializes each into a 1-tile texture sampled on the faces. Fixed a hard SIGABRT: a face recipe is only fs_main, so the full Effect shader assembly (header+math+recipe, formerly v8_app-only) was extracted to a pure shared gpu/effect_assemble.zig used by BOTH the V8 host and the no-V8 loader. Verified: forced-material render proof shows real brick on every face; clean render proof PASS; V8 host + loader both build. Note: only built-in shader-catalog materials resolve in the headless bake; custom-Materialized/react looks still fall back to color (follow-up).
